issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

k8sServiceAccount.description:
Name of Service Account that backs the entity (Apps, Envs) for RBAC
Has to be pre-created

providerType.description:
Provider type for this security profile. Used by {@link #inst} to determine which
CloudSecurityProfile subtype (Aws, Azure, Gcp, or OnPrem) to return.

If set to a specific provider type (AWS, AZURE, GCP, or ONPREM), {@link #inst} will return
the corresponding subtype profile. If not specified, {@link #inst} will infer the provider type
from the Kubernetes cluster type (GKE, AKS, EKS).

managedIdentityName.description: User provided name of the associated Azure Managed Identity

managedIdentityClientId.description: System generated client-id for the associated Azure Managed Identity

resourceGroup.description: Name of the Azure resource group of the associated Azure Managed Identity

aksOidcIssuerUrl.description:
The OpenID Connect (OIDC) Issuer URL of your AKS cluster that authenticates the kubernetes tokens.
You can retrieve this information via 'az aks show --name "CLUSTER_NAME" --resource-group "RESOURCE_GROUP" --query "oidcIssuerProfile.issuerUrl" --output tsv'.

federatedIdentityCredentialName.description: Name of the federated identity credential between the Azure Managed Identity, the Kubernetes Service Account issuer, and the Kubernetes Service Account.
